prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one completely finished hand-painted landscape 16:9 Chinese Daoist chibi fishing-game UI, a single full-screen design. Match the attached references with high fidelity: image 1 approved mail art, image 2 approved team art, image 3 current fishing gameplay art. The first two provide the exact family of round jade-green title plaques and primary buttons, warm ivory silk-paper panels, thin warm-gold rims, delicate ruyi/cloud motifs, soft painted shading and refined jade/metal materials. The third anchors the bright shallow-sea fishing setting and item language. Do not copy any old reference names, dates, data, mail content or existing functional layout.
Rendering: high-definition premium chibi game art with smooth rounded forms, delicate brushwork, warm modest highlights; jade/teal, warm ivory and fine gold dominate, small red tassels only at edges. No plastic toy gloss, no photorealistic skin, no blurry collage, no dense noise. Outside the main window, a narrow bright jade-blue fishing-sea backdrop may show through. Keep the main ivory content area calm, margins generous, icons distinctive, typography large enough to read. A jade title plaque centered at the top, circular close X upper right, strong alignment and clear primary/secondary action hierarchy.
Text policy: Chinese copy must be crisp and match the brief exactly; use a tasteful Chinese title and clear dark-jade body text. Only the brief's concise functional words and sample values, no extra paragraphs, no watermark, no device frame, no explanation board. This is a game screen art concept, not a poster or wireframe. In-game currency only where applicable.
Task-specific content and layout:
16:9 friends window 好友. Tabs 好友 / 申请 / 查找. Left three original chibi portrait rows named 渔舟客 / 青荷 / 云帆, status 在线 / 捕鱼中 / 离线, distinct faces and outfits. Right selected friend profile with jade portrait frame, concise scene 浅海渔场 and actions 邀请同游 / 查看资料. Bottom 添加好友. No guild or team lists copied from reference.
All displayed amounts and states are illustrative visual examples. Keep critical labels and controls fully inside the canvas, no cropping.
